messages:
alex: Quick ping — opened PR #2147 to simplify a tiny local refactor in kvcache. The change is just a rename + small var cleanup (ctx -> reqCtx) to avoid shadowing with other ctx vars. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2147. CI is unhappy with one lint and a fmt nit. Hoping for one approver and merge today if CI goes green.

sam: skimmed the diff — looks safe to me. two tiny q's: 1) why reqCtx vs requestCtx? is brevity preferred here? 2) do we need a changelog line?

alex: good q. I picked reqCtx to keep it consistent with nearby files (we use reqCtx in serving/handlers). RequestCtx would be clearer but longer; happy to change if folks prefer. I can add a changelog line in the PR description. I already ran gofmt but CI still flagged goimports ordering on one file.

nora: CI failure is from lint complaining about a generated protobuf file being edited by gofmt; the change touched a vendored/generated file by accident. Can you revert that chunk or mark generated? Also run `make fmt` and `git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit` to fold formatting fixes into the same commit.

alex: ack — I see the generated file diff now. I'll revert that hunk and re-run `make fmt`. thanks for the tip.

maria: quick review: ✅ overall. Would prefer `requestCtx` in the public handler signature, but `reqCtx` is fine for internal helpers. One request before merge: please add a tiny unit test that ensures logs still include the `user_id` key after the rename (we've had regressions here before). Also add a one-line changelog entry. + :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build/format-check: failed — goimports errors in pkg/serving/handler.go (ordering)

alex: pushing fix now. local `make fmt` and `goimports -w .` done, removed the accidental generated-file change. new push incoming.

sam: quick nit: in handler.go can we rename a local var `u` to `userID`? small readability win. Example:```diff
- u := reqCtx.Value("user")
- if u == nil { return nil }
+ userID := reqCtx.Value("user")
+ if userID == nil { return nil }
```

nora: agree with sam. tiny, but makes stack traces easier to scan.

alex: done — pushed new commit with the var rename + test + changelog. CI now running.

ci-bot: build/all: passed — all checks green

maria: approved and left a small comment about the test name (suggest `TestHandler_UserIDPropagation`). LGTM otherwise, merging after CI. :party_blob:

alex: thanks everyone — merging now and will watch post-merge for any regressions. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
